declarations.notes: Persistent AVL multimap; keys and values are arbitrary bytes, with copied inputs/views and retained immutable versions. Empty value lists remain explicitly present.

existing_uri_policy: Text.Uri is unchanged and retains its earlier strict UTF-8 URI policies.
intentional_differences: Arbitrary decoded and preserved URL data use Bytes. url-to-text is Option String. URL/query/userinfo byte storage is copied at public boundaries and immutable internally.

Query updates and URL field edits return persistent values; UrlParts snapshots provide all independently assignable fields. Nil pointer/map receiver behavior is represented with explicit Option and empty values.
The default query field limit is10000; url-parse-query-limit is explicit, inclusive and zero means unbounded. Environment compatibility overrides are not consulted.
HTTP/HTTPS multiple-colon authorities use strict validation. Environment compatibility overrides are not consulted.

UrlFailure exposes structured categories, exact byte details and offsets. Diagnostic text uses byte-safe ASCII quoting and independent wording; generic UrlError cause preserves typed causes and explicit temporary/timeout classification.
Serialization produces fresh bytes and cannot return an operational error; unmarshalling returns a fresh parsed URL. Append produces a fresh prefix+URL allocation.

Method joining preserves the original URL on malformed escaped elements; url-join-path-checked additionally exposes the failure. Top-level joining wraps its failure with operation join and original base bytes.
validation_status: Full implementations and frozen dual-frontend corpora are under final source/hash validation; parent-owned serial Rust target and coordinated timing remain integration gates.
